a: Nigeria has hundreds of languages; English is official.
Major groups include Hausa, Yoruba, and Igbo among many others.
The Niger Delta is an oil-rich region in southern Nigeria.
Harmattan is a dry dusty wind season affecting West Africa.
Rainy seasons vary by region; south often has longer rains.
Nigeria has many federal, state, and private universities.
The naira is often written as ₦.
Super Eagles represent Nigeria in African football competitions.
Independence Day is celebrated on October 1.
FCT means Federal Capital Territory, home to Abuja.
